label: FuelPrice
description: A retail fuel price observation — one area, one product, one weekly period (EIA retail series as served by fuel.rootz.global). No schema.org type fits a price observation, so this is an epistery-published vocabulary. The source signs the series; each object links back to its living origin, where the current week is always fresher than any index.

trust.note: Reserved — the observation's proof points (source series id, signer standing) declared here as the market defines them.
